novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a branch-level mechanistic hypothesis: “competing branches coexist in the residual stream” and the model has “a preference among them” before serially verbalizing them, enabling losing branches to be suppressed. Searches for “pre-encoded alternative reasoning branches residual stream linear probe,” “branch point winning losing chain-of-thought activation steering,” and “pre-committed answers CoT” found the closest work, Post-Hoc Reasoning in Chain of Thought: Decoding and Steering Pre-Committed Answers (2026), which already decodes and causally steers final answers before CoT, alongside Answer Convergence as a Signal for Early Stopping in Reasoning (2025), which uses internal activations to shorten reasoning. Moving from pre-decoded final answers and activation-based stopping to decoding ranked alternative approaches at individual branch points is a substantive change in unit of analysis and operationalization, but it is a natural extension of those established ideas rather than a fundamentally new interpretability paradigm.
